name: Love Letter
source:
Mia is a normal high school girl with a huge crush on a handsome, popular boy at her school, Mikio. After working up the courage, she decides to give him a love letter.
However, in trying to get it back, Mia ends up immersing herself in Mikio's life outside of school.

[From [url=https://lunariamv.tumblr.com/post/750240335473623040]the developer's blog[/url]]
